```{r datasets}
save_tab(data_tab, "plasmode-data-table")
# (c) model table: bases per dataset (R/constants.R BASES$default and BASES$ecg8)
model_tab <- DS |>
  transmute(
    dataset, model = "Y(t) ~ α(t) + ∫X(s)β(s,t)ds + z γ(t), Gaussian, identity link",
    `intercept basis k` = if_else(app == "ecg_roahd", 40L, 12L),
    `gamma(t) basis k` = if_else(app == "ecg_roahd", 30L, 12L),
    `ff basis (s × t)` = "8 × 10",
    `R²` = R2,
    `ff EDF REML / NCV / MID` = sprintf("%s / %s / %s", f(edf_ff_REML, 1), f(edf_ff_NCV, 1), f(edf_ff_MID, 1)),
    `total EDF REML / NCV / MID` = sprintf("%s / %s / %s", f(edf_total_REML, 1), f(edf_total_NCV, 1), f(edf_total_MID, 1)),
    `MID interior` = mid_interior
  )
save_tab(model_tab, "plasmode-model-table")
edf_tab <- DS |>
  transmute(dataset, `alpha(t): REML / NCV / MID` = sprintf("%s / %s / %s", f(edf_alpha_REML, 1), f(edf_alpha_NCV, 1), f(edf_alpha_MID, 1)),
            `ff REML / NCV / MID` = sprintf("%s / %s / %s", f(edf_ff_REML, 1), f(edf_ff_NCV, 1), f(edf_ff_MID, 1)),
            `gamma(t): REML / NCV / MID` = sprintf("%s / %s / %s", f(edf_gamma_REML, 1), f(edf_gamma_NCV, 1), f(edf_gamma_MID, 1)),
            `total REML / NCV / MID` = sprintf("%s / %s / %s", f(edf_total_REML, 1), f(edf_total_NCV, 1), f(edf_total_MID, 1)))
save_tab(edf_tab, "plasmode-edf-table")
# (d) residual / dependence table
dep_tab <- DS |>
  transmute(dataset, role, DE, `DE/D` = DE_per_D, `lag 1 step` = lag1, `lag 10%` = lag10, `lag 25%` = lag25,
            `neg. corr. share` = neg_share, `min r` = min_r, `sd ratio` = sd_ratio, FPC90 = fpc90, `rank X` = rank_X, `phase share` = phase_share)
save_tab(dep_tab, "plasmode-dependence-table")
block_tab <- DS |>
  filter(role == "stress test") |>
  transmute(dataset,
            `block rule` = c(ocean = "3 consecutive monthly casts (cost check; the autocorrelation rule gives single casts)", aemet = "complete-linkage clusters of station distance cut at 250 km (mismatch arm: 150 km)", adelaide = "2 consecutive frame curves (10 weeks)")[app],
            `blocks` = n_blocks, `block size` = if_else(block_size_min == block_size_max, as.character(block_size_min), sprintf("%d–%d", block_size_min, block_size_max)), `alt. blocks` = n_blocks_alt,
            `score corr. within` = score_corr_within, `score corr. between` = score_corr_between, `between pairs` = n_pairs_between)
save_tab(block_tab, "plasmode-block-table")
ecg8_note <- "intercept k = 40 and γ k = 30 for ECG 8-lead because with k = 12 neither the functional intercept nor the LBBB effect can follow the QRS complex (22% of the REML residual sum of squares was mean-curve misfit; 0.2% with the larger bases), so that mean structure does not leak into the frozen truth's residuals"
```

## Datasets and models

Nine datasets, each fitted with the study's model Y(t) ~ α(t) + ∫X(s)β(s,t)ds + z γ(t)
(Gaussian, identity link; ff basis 8 × 10, intercept and γ(t) bases k = 12, except
`r ecg8_note`). Six datasets with independent curves are counted in the consistency
criterion; three whose curves are serially or spatially dependent units are stress tests.
The cardiology datasets are patient or volunteer data of N. Bouchahda's group: they are
described here in aggregate only and never enter the repository. @tbl-data-table lists the
data, @tbl-model-table the fitted models and their frozen fits (EDF per term in @tbl-edf-table), @tbl-dep-table the residual
dependence and covariate diagnostics, @tbl-block-table the block construction of the stress
tests; the test-cohort balance is tabulated at the end of the section on the construction of the plasmode cells.

```{r dataset-paragraphs}
#| output: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(DS))) {
  d <- DS[i, ]
  cat(sprintf(
    "**%s** (%s; %s). %s: %d curves; response: %s, native grid %s (fitted grid: %s); functional covariate: %s; scalar covariate z: %s. Preprocessing: %s. Fit: R² %s, ff EDF %s (REML) vs %s (NCV); residual design effect %s (DE/D %s), lag-1 correlation %s, %s%% negative correlations (minimum r %s), SD ratio along t %s, %d FPCs for 90%% of the residual variance, covariate rank %d, phase share %s%%%s. Why it is here: %s.\n\n",
    d$dataset, d$source, d$access,
    if (d$role == "counted") "Counted dataset" else "Stress test",
    d$G, d$response, d$native, d$grid_note, d$covariate, d$z, d$prep,
    f(d$R2, 2), f(d$edf_ff_REML, 1), f(d$edf_ff_NCV, 1), f(d$DE, 1), f(d$DE_per_D, 2), f(d$lag1, 2),
    f(100 * d$neg_share, 0), f(d$min_r, 2), f(d$sd_ratio, 0), as.integer(d$fpc90), as.integer(d$rank_X), f(100 * d$phase_share, 0),
    if (d$role == "stress test") sprintf("; %d blocks of %s curves, residual-score correlation %s within and %s between blocks", d$n_blocks, if (d$block_size_min == d$block_size_max) as.character(d$block_size_min) else sprintf("%d–%d", d$block_size_min, d$block_size_max), f(d$score_corr_within, 2), f(d$score_corr_between, 2)) else "",
    d$interest
  ))
}
```

MID is a third smoothing level, not a midpoint in fit: its ff EDF lies strictly between the
two fits for every term on `r sum(DATASETS$mid_interior)` of 9 datasets
(`r paste(APP_LABELS[as.character(DATASETS$app[DATASETS$mid_interior])], collapse = ", ")`)
and exceeds both fits' on `r paste(APP_LABELS[as.character(mid_above$app)], collapse = ", ")`.

## Construction of the plasmode cells

Each dataset's model is fitted to the real data by REML and by curve-blocked NCV; each
fit's fitted means are frozen as a truth, and the MID truth refits with every smoothing
parameter fixed at the log-midpoint of the REML and NCV values. Replicates add each
subject's real residual curve (from the REML or the NCV fit) with a random sign, attached
to its own covariates; the ECG strain data add beat-to-beat difference curves as a
model-free error source at two scales. Cells cross truth source × residual source × G (all
subjects or 40); the three stress tests add block-flip cells with an imposed within-block
dependence and a block-NCV arm. `r n_cells_p` cells, `r n_tasks_p` tasks, NCV converged in
`r f(100 * conv_p, 1)`% of them. The mean estimand is the conditional mean of a fixed test
cohort of 50 subjects (a seeded sample on `r sum(cohort$cohort == "seeded sample of 50")`
datasets, the first 50 rows on `r sum(cohort$cohort == "first 50 rows")`; the choice was made
by a permutation test of the cohort's balance in the scalar covariate and the first three
covariate scores; table below), evaluated at the native grid points and scored conditional
on that cohort. Nothing per subject leaves the analysis: all tables are aggregates.

Replicate data sets are $Y^*_i(t) = \mu_i(t) + w_i\,e_{\pi(i)}(t)$: $\mu_i$ is subject i's fitted mean under the frozen truth,
$e_j$ the residual curve of subject j from the REML or the NCV fit to the real data (or a beat-to-beat difference
curve), $w_i = \pm 1$ an independent random sign per curve (curve flips) or one sign per block of curves (block flips,
stress tests only, all subjects), and $\pi$ the identity (attached: each subject keeps its own residual curve) or a
random permutation (detached: residual curves reassigned across subjects; running data only, @tbl-detached). At
G = 40 every replicate draws its own random subset of 40 subjects. Each cell has 200 replicates; the replicate's
random draws (signs, subset, permutation) depend only on the replicate number, so cells of a dataset are paired.
Every replicate is fitted and scored exactly like a synthetic data set (same bases except ECG 8-lead, same arms).

```{r detached}
det_tab <- P |>
  filter(app == "running", flip == "curve", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"), arm %in% c("reml_model", "reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2", "ncv_cl2_bias")) |>
  semi_join(P |> filter(error == "detached") |> distinct(app, truth, residual, G), by = c("app", "truth", "residual", "G")) |>
  select(truth, residual, G, estimand, arm, error, coverage_mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = error, values_from = coverage_mean) |>
  mutate(difference = detached - attached, arm = ARM_LABELS[arm], estimand = ESTIMAND_LABELS[estimand]) |>
  arrange(truth, desc(G), estimand, arm)
save_tab(det_tab, "plasmode-attached-detached")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-detached
#| tbl-cap: "Running data: coverage with each subject's own residual curve (attached) and with residual curves permuted across subjects (detached), per truth and residual source, G and interval."
show(det_tab, digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Plasmode test cohort for the mean estimand: rule, permutation p-value of the balance test and standardised mean differences (cohort vs all subjects) of the scalar covariate and the first three covariate scores."
```

## Coverage per arm, truth source, residual source and G

```{r fig-plasmode-coverage}
#| fig-cap: "Plasmode coverage of the mean and of β at G = all subjects, by dataset (rows), truth source (y axis), residual source (shape) and arm (colour). The AR(1) arm was run in the (MID, REML residuals) cell of every dataset and in two further ECG strain and running cells. Bars ± 2 MC SE."
#| fig-height: 7.6
d <- P_POOL |>
  filter(estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"), arm %in% c(MAIN_ARMS, "ar1_model"), residual %in% c("REML", "NCV")) |>
  mutate(arm = label_arm(arm), estimand = label_estimand(estimand), app = label_app(app), truth = factor(truth, TRUTH_LEVELS), residual = RESIDUAL_LABELS[residual])
fig <- ggplot(d, aes(coverage_mean, truth, colour = arm, shape = residual)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = LEVEL, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = coverage_mean - 2 * coverage_se, xmax = coverage_mean + 2 * coverage_se), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(app ~ estimand) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ARM_COLOURS, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 1), name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(x = "coverage (grid average, nominal 0.95)", y = "truth source") +
  theme_doc
save_fig(fig, "plasmode-coverage", 6.5, 8.4)
fig
pool_wide <- POOL_MEANS_MAIN |>
  filter(arm %in% c(MAIN_ARMS, "ar1_model"), estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |>
  select(app, role, estimand, arm, coverage) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = coverage) |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app)) |>
  arrange(role, app, estimand) |>
  pretty()
save_tab(POOL_MEANS_MAIN, "plasmode-pool-means")
pv <- \(a, e, r = "counted") pool_wide[[ARM_LABELS[a]]][pool_wide$estimand == ESTIMAND_LABELS[e] & pool_wide$role == r]
```

Across the pooled cells of the six counted datasets (@fig-plasmode-coverage,
@tbl-plasmode-pool) model-based intervals cover the mean at `r rng(pv("reml_model", "mean"))`
and β at `r rng(pv("reml_model", "beta"))`; REML + CL2 covers them at
`r rng(pv("reml_cl2", "mean"))` and `r rng(pv("reml_cl2", "beta"))`. The bias-aware NCV
interval covers the mean at `r rng(pv("ncv_cl2_bias", "mean"))` and β at
`r rng(pv("ncv_cl2_bias", "beta"))`, NCV + CL2 alone `r rng(pv("ncv_cl2", "beta"))` for β.
On the three stress tests every arm is lower: REML + CL2 `r rng(pv("reml_cl2", "beta", "stress test"))`
for β and `r rng(pv("reml_cl2", "mean", "stress test"))` for the mean; CL2 improves on the
model-based intervals on every dataset but is not calibrated on the stress tests. Their
curve-flip replicates have independent errors across curves, so these shortfalls are
properties of the datasets' covariates and residual shapes, not of between-curve
dependence (@sec-block isolates that). REML + CL2's coverage is nearly flat across truth source
and residual source (largest range within a counted dataset:
`r pp(max((POOL_MEANS |> filter(role == "counted", arm == "reml_cl2", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |> mutate(r = coverage_max - coverage_min))$r))`;
within a stress test up to `r pp(max((POOL_MEANS |> filter(role == "stress test", arm == "reml_cl2", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |> mutate(r = coverage_max - coverage_min))$r))`
on the weather data),
whereas the bias-aware NCV interval's β coverage moves with the truth source: on the counted
datasets `r rng(bt("ncv_cl2_bias", "REML", role_sel = "counted"))` under the REML-fitted truth,
`r rng(bt("ncv_cl2_bias", "MID", role_sel = "counted"))` under MID and `r rng(bt("ncv_cl2_bias", "NCV", role_sel = "counted"))`
under the NCV-fitted truth.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-plasmode-pool
#| tbl-cap: "Mean coverage over each dataset's pooled cells (all subjects, own residual curves, curve flips; all truth × residual combinations) per arm. The AR(1) column is the (MID, REML residuals) cell."
show(pool_wide)
```

### Lower tails, by truth source

```{r plasmode-tails}
tails_p <- POOL_MEANS |>
  filter(arm %in% MAIN_ARMS, estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |>
  select(app, role, estimand, arm, q05_mean, q05_min) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c(q05_mean, q05_min)) |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app)) |>
  arrange(role, app, estimand)
names(tails_p) <- sub("q05_mean_", "q05 mean: ", sub("q05_min_", "q05 min: ", names(tails_p)))
save_tab(pretty(tails_p), "plasmode-lower-tails")
tv <- \(a, e, col = "q05 mean", r = "counted") tails_p[[paste0(col, ": ", a)]][tails_p$estimand == e & tails_p$role == r]
# REML + CL2 per truth source (beta, G = all, model residuals)
cl2_truth <- by_truth |>
  filter(arm == "reml_cl2", estimand == "beta") |>
  select(app, role, truth, coverage, q05) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = truth, values_from = c(coverage, q05)) |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app)) |>
  select(app, role, `cov REML truth` = coverage_REML, `cov MID` = coverage_MID, `cov NCV truth` = coverage_NCV, `q05 REML truth` = q05_REML, `q05 MID` = q05_MID, `q05 NCV truth` = q05_NCV) |>
  arrange(role, app)
share90 <- HMC_P |> filter(method == "reml_cl2") |> mutate(dataset = label_app(app)) |> select(dataset, truth, share_below_90, coverage_q05)
save_tab(cl2_truth, "plasmode-remlcl2-by-truth")
ct <- \(col, r = "counted") cl2_truth[[col]][cl2_truth$role == r]
```

REML + CL2's 5% pointwise quantile is `r rng(tv("reml_cl2", "beta"))` for β and
`r rng(tv("reml_cl2", "mean"))` for the mean on the counted datasets (mean over pool cells;
worst cell `r rng(tv("reml_cl2", "beta", "q05 min"))` for β); the bias-aware NCV interval's
is `r rng(tv("ncv_cl2_bias", "beta"))` for β and NCV + CL2's `r rng(tv("ncv_cl2", "beta"))`
(@tbl-plasmode-tails). REML + CL2's own tail depends on the truth source (@tbl-cl2-truth):
under the REML-fitted truth its β quantile on the counted datasets is `r rng(ct("q05 REML truth"))`
(stress tests `r rng(ct("q05 REML truth", "stress test"))`), under the NCV-fitted truth
`r rng(ct("q05 NCV truth"))`; on the running data under the REML truth
`r f(100 * share90$share_below_90[share90$dataset == "running" & share90$truth == "REML"], 0)`%
of β's grid points have pointwise coverage below 0.90 (DTI
`r f(100 * share90$share_below_90[share90$dataset == "DTI" & share90$truth == "REML"], 0)`%).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cl2-truth

```

```{r zstats-plasmode}
zp_avail <- !is.null(ZP)
zp_tab <- if (zp_avail) ZP |>
  filter(fit == "REML", flip == "curve", error == "attached", G > 40, residual %in% c("REML", "NCV"), estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |>
  group_by(app, truth, estimand) |>
  summarise(across(c(z_mean_cl2, z_sd_cl2, share_big_cl2, z_mean_model, z_sd_model, share_big_model), mean), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(role = if_else(app %in% APP_COUNTED, "counted", "stress test"), dataset = label_app(app), truth = factor(truth, TRUTH_LEVELS)) |>
  select(dataset, role, truth, estimand, everything(), -app) |>
  arrange(estimand, role, dataset, truth) else NULL
if (zp_avail) save_tab(zp_tab |> mutate(estimand = ESTIMAND_LABELS[estimand]), "plasmode-zstats-reml")
zpb <- if (zp_avail) zp_tab |> filter(estimand == "beta") else NULL
zpv <- \(col, r = "counted", tr = TRUTH_LEVELS) zpb[[col]][zpb$role == r & zpb$truth %in% tr]
zp_worst <- if (zp_avail) zpb |> arrange(desc(z_sd_cl2)) |> slice(1) else NULL
zp_cell_max <- if (zp_avail) ZP |> filter(fit == "REML", flip == "curve", error == "attached", G > 40, estimand == "beta", app %in% APP_STRESS) |> summarise(sd = max(z_sd_cl2), big = share_big_cl2[which.max(z_sd_cl2)]) else NULL
zp_norm_share <- \(sd) 2 * (1 - pnorm(1.96 / sd))
```

`r if (zp_avail) sprintf("The pooled studentised error of the REML fit (descriptive, see the synthetic section for its limits) reads differently on the two groups of datasets (@tbl-zstats-plasmode, means over the two model-residual sources). On the counted datasets the SD of z for β at G = all is %s with %s%% of |z| > 1.96 (mean of z %s): a mild scale error, consistent with the 1–3 pp shortfall. On the stress tests the SD is %s (per-cell maximum %s on %s) with only %s%% of |z| > 1.96, where a normal pivot with SD %s would give %s%%: a scale mixture, i.e. SE failure concentrated on a subset of grid points or replicates rather than a uniform underestimation. With the model-based SE the SD of z is %s on the counted datasets. Under the REML-fitted truth the SD is %s against %s under the NCV-fitted truth (counted datasets). A region-wise view is not available from the stored aggregates.", rng(zpv("z_sd_cl2")), rng(100 * zpv("share_big_cl2"), 1), rng(zpv("z_mean_cl2")), rng(zpv("z_sd_cl2", "stress test")), f(zp_cell_max$sd, 2), zp_worst$dataset, rng(100 * zpv("share_big_cl2", "stress test"), 1), f(zp_worst$z_sd_cl2, 2), f(100 * zp_norm_share(zp_worst$z_sd_cl2), 0), rng(zpv("z_sd_model")), rng(zpv("z_sd_cl2", tr = "REML")), rng(zpv("z_sd_cl2", tr = "NCV"))) else "Studentised-error diagnostics for the plasmode study are pending."`

### G = 40

```{r plasmode-g40}
g40_tab <- g40_app |>
  filter(arm %in% MAIN_ARMS) |>
  mutate(arm = label_arm(arm), app = label_app(app)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = loss) |>
  arrange(role, app, estimand)
save_tab(g40 |> mutate(app = label_app(app)), "plasmode-G40-paired")
g40v <- \(a, e = c("mean", "beta"), r = "counted") g40_app$loss[g40_app$arm == a & g40_app$estimand %in% e & g40_app$role == r]
# the rule on the G = 40 cells (point estimates, no bootstrap flags)
rule40 <- P_G40 |>
  filter(estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"), arm %in% c("ncv_cl2_bias", "reml_cl2")) |>
  group_by(app, role, estimand) |>
  group_modify(\(d, k) rule_both(d)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app)) |>
  arrange(estimand, role, app)
save_tab(rule40, "plasmode-rule-G40-point")
```

With 40 subjects instead of all, REML + CL2 loses `r rng_pp(g40v("reml_cl2"))` on the
counted datasets (paired over truth × residual cells; @tbl-plasmode-g40), the bias-aware
NCV interval `r rng_pp(g40v("ncv_cl2_bias"))` and NCV + CL2 alone `r rng_pp(g40v("ncv_cl2"))`.
The rule's point decisions on the G = 40 cells (no bootstrap flags; @tbl-rule40) are
`r paste(sprintf("%s %s", rule40$app[rule40$estimand == "beta"], rule40$decision_under[rule40$estimand == "beta"]), collapse = ", ")`
for β and `r paste(sprintf("%s %s", rule40$app[rule40$estimand == "mean"], rule40$decision_under[rule40$estimand == "mean"]), collapse = ", ")`
for the mean.

## Estimation by truth source {#sec-estimation-truth}

```{r fig-plasmode-mse}
#| fig-cap: "NCV/REML MSE ratio per plasmode cell (G = all subjects, curve flips) by dataset, truth source (colour) and residual source (shape), with 95% paired bootstrap intervals; log scale."
#| fig-height: 5
d <- PM |>
  filter(error == "attached", flip == "curve", G_label == "all", residual %in% c("REML", "NCV")) |>
  mutate(estimand = label_estimand(estimand), app = label_app(app), truth = factor(truth, TRUTH_LEVELS), residual = RESIDUAL_LABELS[residual])
fig <- ggplot(d, aes(mse_ratio_ncv_reml, app, colour = truth, shape = residual)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ratio_lower, xmax = ratio_upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~estimand, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(REML = "#0072B2", MID = "#009E73", NCV = "#D55E00"), name = "truth") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 1), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "MSE of NCV / MSE of REML", y = NULL) +
  theme_doc
save_fig(fig, "plasmode-mse-ratio", 7.5, 5)
fig
ratio_wide <- RATIO_BY_TRUTH |>
  select(app, role, estimand, truth, ratio) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = truth, values_from = ratio) |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app)) |>
  select(role, app, estimand, REML, MID, NCV) |>
  arrange(estimand, role, app) |>
  pretty()
save_tab(RATIO_BY_TRUTH, "plasmode-mse-ratio-by-truth")
order_ok <- RATIO_BY_TRUTH |> filter(estimand == "beta") |> select(app, truth, ratio) |> pivot_wider(names_from = truth, values_from = ratio) |> mutate(ok = NCV < MID & MID < REML)
losers <- RATIO_BY_TRUTH |> filter(truth == "REML", estimand == "beta", ratio > 1)
# univariate gains with intervals (NCV truth, REML residuals)
uni <- PM |>
  filter(error == "attached", flip == "curve", G_label == "all", truth == "NCV", residual == "REML", estimand %in% c("alpha", "gamma"), ratio_upper < 0.9) |>
  mutate(dataset = label_app(app), value = ci(mse_ratio_ncv_reml, ratio_lower, ratio_upper, 2)) |>
  select(dataset, estimand, value)
wr <- DATASETS |> filter(app %in% c("aemet", "running"))
```

The NCV/REML MSE ratio depends on which fit supplied the truth (@fig-plasmode-mse,
@tbl-plasmode-mse). For β it is `r rng(rt("NCV", "beta"))` under the NCV-fitted truth,
`r rng(rt("MID", "beta"))` under MID and `r rng(rt("REML", "beta"))` under the REML-fitted
truth; NCV loses under the REML truth on `r nrow(losers)` datasets
(`r paste(APP_LABELS[losers$app], collapse = ", ")`), and the ordering NCV truth < MID <
REML truth holds on `r sum(order_ok$ok)` of 9. For the mean the ratios are
`r rng(rt("NCV", "mean"))`, `r rng(rt("MID", "mean"))` and `r rng(rt("REML", "mean"))`. The
gains are not confined to the surface in the plasmode study: for γ(t) the ratio is
`r rng(rt("NCV", "gamma"))` under the NCV truth and `r rng(rt("REML", "gamma"))` under the
REML truth, for α(t) `r rng(rt("NCV", "alpha"))` and `r rng(rt("REML", "alpha"))`, with
resolved univariate gains (bootstrap interval below 0.9, NCV truth, REML residuals) on
`r paste(sprintf("%s %s %s", uni$dataset, ESTIMAND_LABELS[uni$estimand], uni$value), collapse = "; ")`.
Changing the truth source changes the truth's shape and signal as well as its smoothness,
and an NCV-derived truth aligns the target with the NCV fit, so this is a truth-source
sensitivity and not evidence for a pure smoothness mechanism: on the weather data NCV is rougher than REML (ff EDF
`r f(wr$edf_ff_NCV[wr$app == "aemet"], 1)` vs `r f(wr$edf_ff_REML[wr$app == "aemet"], 1)`)
yet wins for β under all three truths (REML truth `r f(rt("REML", "beta")[RATIO_BY_TRUTH$app[RATIO_BY_TRUTH$truth == "REML" & RATIO_BY_TRUTH$estimand == "beta"] == "aemet"], 2)`),
and on the running data the two fits have the same ff EDF (ratio
`r f(wr$edf_ratio[wr$app == "running"], 2)`) yet the MID-truth ratio is
`r f(rt("MID", "beta")[RATIO_BY_TRUTH$app[RATIO_BY_TRUTH$truth == "MID" & RATIO_BY_TRUTH$estimand == "beta"] == "running"], 2)`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-plasmode-mse
#| tbl-cap: "NCV/REML MSE ratio per dataset and truth source (geometric mean over residual sources, G = all subjects)."
show(ratio_wide)
```

## The per-dataset rule and cross-dataset consistency {#sec-plasmode-rule}

```{r plasmode-rule}
rule_all <- PR |>
  filter(pool == "all") |>
  transmute(
    dataset = label_app(app), role, estimand, n_cells,
    `CE proposal` = ci(ce_proposal, ce_proposal_lower, ce_proposal_upper),
    `CE fallback` = ci(ce_fallback, ce_fallback_lower, ce_fallback_upper),
    `score ratio` = ci(score_ratio, score_ratio_lower, score_ratio_upper, 2),
    decision, class, `Q1 class (REML)` = q1_class_reml, `Q1 class (NCV)` = q1_class_ncv
  ) |>
  arrange(role, estimand, dataset)
save_tab(PR, "plasmode-rule")
save_tab(PC, "plasmode-consistency")
prc <- PR |> filter(pool == "all", role == "counted")
prs <- PR |> filter(pool == "all", role == "stress test")
n_labels <- prc |> filter(class == "N", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))
q1_gain <- prc |> filter(estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))
q1_gain_s <- prs |> filter(estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))
# the symmetric criterion on the nine-dataset pools (point estimates)
rule_sym <- P_POOL |>
  filter(estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"), arm %in% c("ncv_cl2_bias", "reml_cl2")) |>
  group_by(app, role, estimand) |>
  group_modify(\(d, k) rule_both(d)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app)) |>
  arrange(estimand, role, app)
save_tab(rule_sym, "plasmode-rule-both-criteria-point")
sym_diff <- rule_sym |> filter(decision_under != decision_sym)
rv_pl <- RV |> filter(data == "plasmode") |> mutate(group = recode(group, ecg_gls4 = "ECG strain (79-subject frame)", running = "running (first-50 cohort)"))
```

The rule was applied per dataset on its pooled cells (@tbl-plasmode-rule). Question 1 is
consistent: on every counted dataset CL2 reduces the calibration error of the REML fit's
intervals by `r rng(q1_gain$q1_reml)` (stress tests `r rng(q1_gain_s$q1_reml)`; class C
everywhere for both fits; consistency label "`r PC$q1_reml[PC$estimand == "beta"]`"). The
recipe decision is not: for β the classes are `r relabel_apps(PC$classes[PC$estimand == "beta"])`
and the label "`r PC$rule[PC$estimand == "beta"]`"; for the mean
`r relabel_apps(PC$classes[PC$estimand == "mean"])`, "`r PC$rule[PC$estimand == "mean"]`". The
proposal is the point decision on `r sum(prc$decision == "P" & prc$estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))`
of the 12 counted dataset-estimand pairs, the fallback on
`r sum(prc$decision == "F" & prc$estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))`, neither on
`r sum(prc$decision == "N" & prc$estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))`, equivalent on
`r sum(prc$decision == "E" & prc$estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))`.

The N labels are fragile. They arise because the fallback's calibration error for β
exceeds 2 pp on `r paste(APP_LABELS[n_labels$app], collapse = " and ")`
(`r paste(sprintf("%s: %s", APP_LABELS[n_labels$app], ci(n_labels$ce_fallback, n_labels$ce_fallback_lower, n_labels$ce_fallback_upper)), collapse = "; ")`),
i.e. by `r rng_pp(n_labels$ce_fallback - ADEQUATE)` with bootstrap intervals that include
2 pp, while the proposal's is `r rng(n_labels$ce_proposal)`. Under the
symmetric criterion (point decisions on the same nine-dataset pools, @tbl-rule-sym) the
decision differs from the undercoverage-only one on `r nrow(sym_diff)` of `r nrow(rule_sym)`
dataset-estimand pairs`r if (nrow(sym_diff)) paste0(" (", paste(sprintf("%s %s: %s vs %s", sym_diff$app, ESTIMAND_LABELS[sym_diff$estimand], sym_diff$decision_under, sym_diff$decision_sym), collapse = "; "), ")") else ""`;
these are point classifications without bootstrap flags, and the agreement is not a
robustness result: the proposal already fails the undercoverage bound for β on
`r sum(rule_sym$ce_proposal_under[rule_sym$estimand == "beta"] > ADEQUATE)` of 9 datasets, so
adding overcoverage to the criterion cannot change its class there.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-plasmode-rule
#| tbl-cap: "The recommendation rule per dataset (pool = all attached curve-flip cells with all subjects), with 95% replicate-bootstrap intervals; classes as defined in the reading guide."
show(rule_all)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rule-sym
#| tbl-cap: "The rule on the nine-dataset pools under both calibration criteria (point estimates; under = undercoverage only, sym = symmetric)."
show(rule_sym |> select(app, role, estimand, n_cells, ce_proposal_under, ce_fallback_under, ce_proposal_sym, ce_fallback_sym, score_ratio, decision_under, decision_sym))
```

## Attribution: truth source versus residual source

```{r attribution}
att <- PA |>
  filter(!grepl("beat", effect), quantity %in% c("log_mse_ratio", "coverage:reml_cl2", "coverage:ncv_cl2_bias", "coverage:reml_model")) |>
  mutate(dataset = label_app(app), value = ci(estimate, lower, upper)) |>
  select(dataset, estimand, quantity, effect, value, verdict)
att_wide <- att |>
  select(-verdict) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = effect, values_from = value) |>
  left_join(att |> filter(effect == "residual") |> select(dataset, estimand, quantity, `residual verdict` = verdict), by = c("dataset", "estimand", "quantity")) |>
  arrange(quantity, estimand, dataset)
save_tab(PA, "plasmode-attribution")
lm_truth <- PA |> filter(quantity == "log_mse_ratio", effect == "truth", estimand == "beta")
lm_resid <- PA |> filter(quantity == "log_mse_ratio", effect == "residual", estimand == "beta")
lm_int <- PA |> filter(quantity == "log_mse_ratio", effect == "interaction", estimand == "beta")
cov_resid <- PA |> filter(startsWith(quantity, "coverage:"), effect == "residual")
cov_exc <- cov_resid |> filter(verdict != "small") |> mutate(dataset = label_app(app), arm = ARM_LABELS[sub("coverage:", "", quantity)])
flips <- PF |> mutate(dataset = label_app(app))
save_tab(flips, "plasmode-flips")
n_pf <- sum(flips$flips & ((flips$REML == "P" & flips$NCV == "F") | (flips$REML == "F" & flips$NCV == "P")))
```

On the 2 × 2 of REML/NCV truths × REML/NCV residuals (G = all), the truth-source main
effect on log(MSE NCV / MSE REML) for β is `r rng(lm_truth$estimate)` (NCV truth minus
REML truth; the ratio is multiplied by `r rng(exp(lm_truth$estimate))`), the residual-source
main effect `r rng(lm_resid$estimate)` and the interaction `r rng(lm_int$estimate)`
(@tbl-attribution). The residual-source effect on the log ratio is "small" (inside
log[0.95, 1.05] with its interval) on `r plural(sum(lm_resid$verdict == "small"), "dataset")`,
"not small" on `r sum(lm_resid$verdict == "not small")`
(`r paste(sprintf("%s %s", APP_LABELS[lm_resid$app[lm_resid$verdict == "not small"]], f(lm_resid$estimate[lm_resid$verdict == "not small"], 3)), collapse = ", ")`)
and undetermined on the remaining `r sum(lm_resid$verdict == "undetermined")`. Of the
`r nrow(cov_resid)` residual-source effects on coverage, `r sum(cov_resid$verdict == "small")`
are inside ±2 pp with their interval; the exceptions are
`r paste(sprintf("%s %s %s (%s)", cov_exc$dataset, ESTIMAND_LABELS[cov_exc$estimand], cov_exc$arm, pp(cov_exc$estimate)), collapse = "; ")`.
The rule's class on the REML-residual cells alone differs from that on the NCV-residual
cells alone on `r sum(flips$flips)` of `r nrow(flips)` dataset-estimand pairs
(`r paste(sprintf("%s %s: %s vs %s", flips$dataset[flips$flips], flips$estimand[flips$flips], flips$REML[flips$flips], flips$NCV[flips$flips]), collapse = "; ")`);
`r plural(n_pf, "flip")` `r if (n_pf == 1) "is" else "are"` between P and F. Truth source is
the dominant factor for estimation; the residual source matters on two datasets.

## Beat-to-beat errors (ECG strain)

```{r beats}
beat_cov <- P_POOL |>
  filter(app == "ecg_gls4b", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"), arm %in% c(MAIN_ARMS, "ar1_model")) |>
  select(truth, residual, estimand, arm, coverage_mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = coverage_mean) |>
  mutate(residual = RESIDUAL_LABELS[residual], truth = factor(truth, TRUTH_LEVELS)) |>
  arrange(estimand, truth, residual)
beat_mse <- PM |>
  filter(app == "ecg_gls4b", error == "attached", G_label == "all", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |>
  select(truth, residual, estimand, mse_ratio_ncv_reml) |>
  mutate(residual = RESIDUAL_LABELS[residual])
beat_tab <- left_join(beat_cov, beat_mse, by = c("truth", "residual", "estimand")) |> pretty()
save_tab(beat_tab, "plasmode-ecg-beats")
bc <- PA |> filter(grepl("beat", effect), quantity %in% c("coverage:reml_cl2", "coverage:ncv_cl2_bias", "coverage:reml_model"))
bcv <- \(q, which) bc$estimate[bc$quantity == q & grepl(which, bc$effect)]
bm <- \(res, e = "beta") beat_mse$mse_ratio_ncv_reml[beat_mse$residual == RESIDUAL_LABELS[res] & beat_mse$estimand == e]
resid_de <- PD_RESID |> filter(app == "ecg_gls4b") |> select(residual, DE, residual_variance, sd_ratio)
```

The beat-to-beat difference curves are the one error source not shaped by any fit
(design effect `r rng(resid_de$DE[resid_de$residual %in% c("beat_m", "beat_1")], 1)` against
`r rng(resid_de$DE[resid_de$residual == "REML"], 1)` for the REML residuals). With them,
REML + CL2's coverage changes by `r rng_pp(bcv("coverage:reml_cl2", "beat_m"))`
(variance-matched) and `r rng_pp(bcv("coverage:reml_cl2", "beat_1"))` (own scale) relative
to the REML-residual cells with the same truth, the bias-aware NCV interval's by
`r rng_pp(bcv("coverage:ncv_cl2_bias", "beat_m"))` and `r rng_pp(bcv("coverage:ncv_cl2_bias", "beat_1"))`,
and the model-based intervals' by `r rng_pp(bcv("coverage:reml_model", "beat_m"))` and
`r rng_pp(bcv("coverage:reml_model", "beat_1"))` (@tbl-beats). NCV's β gain is larger with
the variance-matched beat errors than with the REML residuals under every truth
(ratios `r rng(bm("beat_m"))` vs `r rng(bm("REML"))`) and smaller at the beats' own scale
(`r rng(bm("beat_1"))`).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-beats
#| tbl-cap: "ECG strain, all 78 subjects: coverage per arm and NCV/REML MSE ratio by truth source and residual source, including the beat-to-beat difference curves."
show(beat_tab)
```

## AR(1) in the plasmode study

```{r plasmode-ar1}
ar1_pt <- P_POOL |>
  filter(arm == "ar1_model", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta", "gamma")) |>
  select(app, role, truth, residual, estimand, coverage_mean, pointwise_q05) |>
  left_join(PFIT |> filter(fit == "AR1") |> select(app, truth, residual, rho, median_time), by = c("app", "truth", "residual")) |>
  left_join(P_POOL |> filter(arm == "reml_cl2") |> select(app, truth, residual, estimand, reml_cl2 = coverage_mean), by = c("app", "truth", "residual", "estimand")) |>
  mutate(dataset = label_app(app), cell_role = if_else(truth == "MID" & residual == "REML", "principal", "sensitivity")) |>
  select(dataset, role, cell_role, truth, residual, estimand, `AR(1)` = coverage_mean, `AR(1) q05` = pointwise_q05, `REML + CL2` = reml_cl2, rho, `fit time s` = median_time) |>
  arrange(role, dataset, cell_role, estimand)
save_tab(pretty(ar1_pt), "plasmode-ar1")
ar1_v <- \(e, r = c("counted", "stress test")) ar1_pt[["AR(1)"]][ar1_pt$estimand == e & ar1_pt$role %in% r & ar1_pt$cell_role == "principal"]
ar1_n_ok <- sum((ar1_pt |> filter(cell_role == "principal", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |> group_by(dataset) |> summarise(ok = all(.data[["AR(1)"]] >= 0.93)))$ok)
ar1_sens_tab <- ar1_pt |> filter(cell_role == "sensitivity", estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))
```

In the common (MID truth, REML residuals) cell the AR(1) working model covers the mean at
`r rng(ar1_v("mean"))` and β at `r rng(ar1_v("beta"))` across the nine datasets
(@tbl-plasmode-ar1), with ρ̂ at `r rng(ar1_pt$rho)` (at its 0.99 cap on the running data)
and median fit times of `r rng(ar1_pt[["fit time s"]], 0)` s. It reaches 0.93 for both
primary estimands on `r plural(ar1_n_ok, "dataset")`. The sensitivity cells (running under
the REML- and NCV-fitted truths, ECG strain with beat errors) give
`r rng(ar1_sens_tab[["AR(1)"]])`.

## Block arm on the dependent-curve datasets {#sec-block}

```{r block}
blk <- PB |>
  filter(name %in% c("mse_ratio_block", "mse_ratio_mismatch", "coverage_loss", "coverage_loss_recipe"), cells %in% c("block_flips", "curve_flips")) |>
  mutate(dataset = label_app(app), value = ci(estimate, lower, upper)) |>
  select(dataset, estimand, verdict, cells, name, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value) |>
  arrange(dataset, estimand, cells)
blk_cov <- PB |>
  filter(startsWith(name, "coverage:"), cells %in% c("block_flips", "curve_flips")) |>
  mutate(dataset = label_app(app), recipe = sub("coverage:", "", name)) |>
  select(dataset, estimand, cells, recipe, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = recipe, values_from = estimate) |>
  arrange(dataset, estimand, cells)
save_tab(PB, "plasmode-block-arm")
save_tab(blk_cov, "plasmode-block-arm-coverage")
bgain <- PB |> filter(name == "mse_ratio_block", cells == "block_flips")
bcost <- PB |> filter(name == "coverage_loss", cells == "curve_flips")
blocks_d <- PD_BLOCKS |> select(app, n_blocks, block_size_min, block_size_max, score_corr_within, score_corr_between)
# between-curve dependence effect: block-flip minus curve-flip coverage of the standard recipes
bf_effect <- PB |>
  filter(name %in% c("coverage:standard", "coverage:reml_curvecl2"), cells %in% c("block_flips", "curve_flips")) |>
  select(app, estimand, name, cells, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = cells, values_from = estimate) |>
  mutate(diff = block_flips - curve_flips, dataset = label_app(app), recipe = recode(name, `coverage:standard` = "bias-aware NCV (curve)", `coverage:reml_curvecl2` = "REML + curve CL2"))
```

The stress tests' curve-flip cells generate independent errors across curves, so the only
evidence about between-curve dependence is the contrast of block-flip against curve-flip
cells. Under imposed block dependence REML + curve-clustered CL2 changes by
`r rng_pp(bf_effect$diff[bf_effect$name == "coverage:reml_curvecl2"])` relative to the
curve-flip cells (bias-aware NCV `r rng_pp(bf_effect$diff[bf_effect$name == "coverage:standard"])`).
Leaving out and clustering on blocks does not help estimation: the paired MSE ratio
block-NCV / NCV is `r rng(bgain$estimate)` (@tbl-block), and under independent curves block
clustering costs `r rng_pp(bcost$estimate)` of coverage. Verdicts:
`r paste(sprintf("%s %s: %s", label_app(bgain$app), bgain$estimand, bgain$verdict), collapse = "; ")`.
Block-clustered CL2 does not recover the shortfall on the weather data (REML + block CL2
`r rng(blk_cov$reml_blockcl2[blk_cov$dataset == "weather" & blk_cov$cells == "block_flips"])`
against REML + curve CL2 `r rng(blk_cov$reml_curvecl2[blk_cov$dataset == "weather" & blk_cov$cells == "block_flips"])`
under block flips); its `r blocks_d$n_blocks[blocks_d$app == "aemet"]` blocks are below the
≥ 40 clusters of the study's operating range, and the mechanism is untested there. The
partition-mismatch arm (150 km blocks against 250 km generating blocks) gives an MSE ratio
of `r rng((PB |> filter(name == "mse_ratio_mismatch", cells == "block_flips"))$estimate)`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-block
#| tbl-cap: "Block arm on the three stress-test datasets: MSE ratio block-NCV / curve-NCV, and the coverage lost by block-clustered CL2 relative to curve-clustered CL2 within a fit and between the two recipes, under imposed block dependence (block flips) and under independent curves (curve flips)."
show(blk)
```

## The hybrid interval and coverage maps in the plasmode study {#sec-hybrid}

```{r hybrid-plasmode}
hyb_p <- HSUM_P |>
  filter(flip == "curve", error == "attached", G > 40, residual %in% c("REML", "NCV"), estimand %in% c("beta", "mean"), arm %in% c("reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2_bias", "hybrid")) |>
  select(cell, app, truth, estimand, arm, coverage_mean, pointwise_q05, width_mean, score_mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c(coverage_mean, pointwise_q05, width_mean, score_mean))
hyb_truth <- hyb_p |>
  group_by(truth, estimand) |>
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    `cov REML+CL2` = mean(coverage_mean_reml_cl2), `cov bias-aware` = mean(coverage_mean_ncv_cl2_bias), `cov hybrid` = mean(coverage_mean_hybrid),
    `q05 REML+CL2` = mean(pointwise_q05_reml_cl2), `q05 bias-aware` = mean(pointwise_q05_ncv_cl2_bias), `q05 hybrid` = mean(pointwise_q05_hybrid),
    `width bias-aware/REML+CL2` = exp(mean(log(width_mean_ncv_cl2_bias / width_mean_reml_cl2))),
    `width hybrid/REML+CL2` = exp(mean(log(width_mean_hybrid / width_mean_reml_cl2))),
    `IS bias-aware/REML+CL2` = exp(mean(log(score_mean_ncv_cl2_bias / score_mean_reml_cl2))),
    `IS hybrid/REML+CL2` = exp(mean(log(score_mean_hybrid / score_mean_reml_cl2))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(truth = factor(truth, TRUTH_LEVELS), estimand = ESTIMAND_LABELS[estimand]) |>
  arrange(estimand, truth)
save_tab(hyb_truth, "plasmode-hybrid-by-truth")
hyb_app <- HP |>
  filter(estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |>
  mutate(dataset = label_app(app)) |>
  select(dataset, estimand, n_cells, incl, cov_reml_cl2, cov_ncv_cl2_bias, cov_hybrid, q05_reml_cl2, q05_ncv_cl2_bias, q05_hybrid, `IS_ncv_cl2_bias/reml_cl2`, `IS_hybrid/reml_cl2`) |>
  arrange(estimand, dataset)
save_tab(HP, "plasmode-hybrid-digest")
hv2 <- \(col, tr, e = "beta(s,t)") hyb_truth[[col]][hyb_truth$truth == tr & hyb_truth$estimand == e]
mcp <- HMC_P |> mutate(dataset = label_app(app))
mcpv <- \(m, tr, col, a = "running") mcp[[col]][mcp$method == m & mcp$truth == tr & mcp$app == a]
```

Averaged over all nine datasets, the hybrid (NCV estimate, REML's CL2 standard error) is worse than REML + CL2 on every
metric under REML-fitted truths and better only under the NCV- and MID-derived truths, partly
by overcovering (@tbl-hybrid-truth; β at G = all, model residuals, equal-weighted means over
the nine datasets and two residual sources, not over truth sources): under the
REML truth it covers `r f(hv2("cov hybrid", "REML"))` against REML + CL2's `r f(hv2("cov REML+CL2", "REML"))`
with 5% quantiles `r f(hv2("q05 hybrid", "REML"))` against `r f(hv2("q05 REML+CL2", "REML"))`
and interval score `r f(hv2("IS hybrid/REML+CL2", "REML"), 2)` times REML + CL2's; under MID
`r f(hv2("cov hybrid", "MID"))` against `r f(hv2("cov REML+CL2", "MID"))` (quantiles
`r f(hv2("q05 hybrid", "MID"))` vs `r f(hv2("q05 REML+CL2", "MID"))`); under the NCV truth
`r f(hv2("cov hybrid", "NCV"))` against `r f(hv2("cov REML+CL2", "NCV"))` (quantiles
`r f(hv2("q05 hybrid", "NCV"))` vs `r f(hv2("q05 REML+CL2", "NCV"))`). Its width equals
REML + CL2's by construction; the bias-aware interval is `r rng(hyb_truth[["width bias-aware/REML+CL2"]][hyb_truth$estimand == "beta(s,t)"], 2)`
times as wide across truth sources. The coverage maps (@fig-maps-plasmode) show where
the intervals built on the NCV estimate fall short under a REML-fitted truth: on the
running data NCV + CL2 has `r f(100 * mcpv("ncv_cl2", "REML", "share_below_90"), 0)`% of
grid points below 0.90 coverage, the bias-aware interval `r f(100 * mcpv("ncv_cl2_bias", "REML", "share_below_90"), 0)`%
and the hybrid `r f(100 * mcpv("hybrid", "REML", "share_below_90"), 0)`%, against REML + CL2's
`r f(100 * mcpv("reml_cl2", "REML", "share_below_90"), 0)`%; the pointwise shortfall of the
bias-aware interval correlates with the truth's curvature (Spearman
`r f(mcpv("ncv_cl2_bias", "REML", "cor_curv_spearman"), 2)` running, `r f(mcpv("ncv_cl2_bias", "REML", "cor_curv_spearman", "dti"), 2)` DTI)
and with (β̂_NCV − β̂_REML)² / se²_CL2,NCV (`r f(mcpv("ncv_cl2_bias", "REML", "cor_delta_spearman"), 2)`,
`r f(mcpv("ncv_cl2_bias", "REML", "cor_delta_spearman", "dti"), 2)`). Under the NCV-fitted
truth the same maps are near nominal for every construction. Per-dataset values are in
@tbl-hybrid-plasmode. On the six counted datasets alone its average coverage under the REML-fitted truth is close to REML + CL2's and its interval score slightly lower; its 5% pointwise quantile is far lower (paper, §6.4).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-hybrid-truth
#| tbl-cap: "Hybrid and bias-aware intervals next to REML + CL2 in the plasmode study by truth source (all subjects, model residuals, equal-weighted mean over the nine datasets): coverage (cov), 5% pointwise quantile (q05), and width and interval score (IS) relative to REML + CL2."
show(hyb_truth, digits = 3)
```

```{r fig-maps-plasmode}
#| fig-cap: "Pointwise coverage of β(s,t) on the running and the DTI data (all subjects, REML residuals) under the REML-fitted and the NCV-fitted truth, for REML + CL2, NCV + CL2, the bias-aware NCV interval and the hybrid; the white contour marks 0.90."
#| fig-height: 5.4
maps_p <- read_maps("plasmode") |>
  filter(truth %in% c("REML", "NCV")) |>
  mutate(method = label_arm(method), dataset = label_app(app), panel = paste(dataset, truth, "truth"))
fig <- ggplot(maps_p, aes(s, t)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill = coverage)) +
  geom_contour(aes(z = coverage), breaks = 0.9, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ method) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1), name = "coverage") +
  coord_equal() + theme_doc + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 6))
save_fig(fig, "coverage-maps-plasmode", 7, 6.5)
fig
```

# Cross-study assessment

```{r cross-data}
syn_core100 <- S |> filter(block == "core", G == 100, estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"))
syn_cov <- \(a, err, e = c("mean", "beta")) syn_core100$coverage_mean[syn_core100$arm == a & syn_core100$error %in% err & syn_core100$estimand %in% e]
syn_ratio <- \(err, e = "beta", blk = "core") MSE_RATIO$ratio[MSE_RATIO$block == blk & MSE_RATIO$G == 100 & MSE_RATIO$error %in% err & MSE_RATIO$estimand == e]

# Per-dataset outcomes: pool means over the attached curve-flip cells at G = all (all truth x
# residual combinations), MSE ratios by truth source (geometric mean over residual sources),
# the AR(1) principal cell, and the dataset diagnostics (REML residuals).
cross <- DATASETS |>
  mutate(app = as.character(app)) |>
  left_join(
    POOL_MEANS_MAIN |> filter(arm %in% c("reml_model", "reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2", "ncv_cl2_bias", "ar1_model"), estimand %in% c("mean", "beta")) |>
      select(app, estimand, arm, coverage) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = c(arm, estimand), values_from = coverage),
    by = "app"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    RATIO_BY_TRUTH |> filter(estimand %in% c("beta", "mean", "gamma", "alpha")) |> select(app, truth, estimand, ratio) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = c(truth, estimand), values_from = ratio, names_prefix = "ratio_"),
    by = "app"
  ) |>
  left_join(g40_app |> filter(arm == "reml_cl2", estimand == "beta") |> select(app, g40_loss_beta = loss), by = "app") |>
  left_join(by_truth |> filter(arm == "ncv_cl2_bias", truth == "REML", estimand == "beta") |> select(app, ba_beta_remltruth = coverage), by = "app") |>
  mutate(
    shortfall_model_beta = LEVEL - reml_model_beta,
    shortfall_model_mean = LEVEL - reml_model_mean,
    shortfall_cl2_beta = LEVEL - reml_cl2_beta,
    log_ratio_MID_beta = log(ratio_MID_beta),
    dataset = label_app(app)
  )
save_tab(cross, "cross-study-dataset-outcomes")
cc <- cross |> filter(role == "counted")
A <- \(x, y, d = cross) rho_text(d[[x]], d[[y]])
Av <- \(x, y, d = cross) rho_perm(d[[x]], d[[y]])$rho
Ap <- \(x, y, d = cross) rho_perm(d[[x]], d[[y]])$p

# Synthetic cell-level quantities for the scatter plots.
syn_cells <- S |>
  filter(estimand %in% c("mean", "beta"), arm %in% c("reml_model", "reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2_bias")) |>
  select(cell, block, family, error, G, signal, truth, D, covariate, basis, estimand, arm, coverage_mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = coverage_mean) |>
  left_join(MSE_RATIO |> select(cell, estimand, ratio), by = c("cell", "estimand")) |>
  left_join(
    EDF |> filter(term == "te(X.smat,X.tmat):L.X", fit %in% c("REML", "NCV")) |> select(cell, fit, edf_mean) |> pivot_wider(names_from = fit, values_from = edf_mean, names_prefix = "edf_") |> mutate(edf_ratio = edf_REML / edf_NCV),
    by = "cell"
  )
# Design effect: realized values (analysis/describe-cells.R on LRZ) where available, else the
# design values of the error kernels (iid 1; OU 8; smooth 11.8 at D = 61 and 47 at D = 241; AR(1) 8).
DE_DESIGN <- c(iid = 1, ou = 8, fpc = 11.8, ou0 = 8)
syn_cells <- syn_cells |>
  mutate(DE_design = if_else(error == "fpc" & D == 241, 47, unname(DE_DESIGN[error])))
if (!is.null(SDE)) syn_cells <- left_join(syn_cells, SDE |> select(cell, DE = design_effect), by = "cell")
has_de <- "DE" %in% names(syn_cells)
if (!has_de) syn_cells$DE <- NA_real_
syn_cells <- syn_cells |> mutate(DE_realized = !is.na(DE), DE_plot = coalesce(DE, DE_design), DE_per_D = DE_plot / D)
de_missing <- syn_cells |> filter(!DE_realized) |> distinct(cell, block, family, error)
save_tab(syn_cells, "cross-study-synthetic-cells")
de_label <- if (has_de) "design effect 1'S1/tr(S) of the residual curves" else "design effect (synthetic: design values, realized values pending)"
syn_de_span <- syn_cells |> filter(block == "core", G == 100, error != "iid") |> summarise(lo = min(DE_plot), hi = max(DE_plot))
```

```{r fig-cross}
#| fig-cap: "Synthetic cells (small coloured points, G = 100; colour = family) and plasmode datasets (large black symbols: circles = counted, triangles = stress tests; labelled) on common axes. (a) model-based coverage of β against the design effect of the residual curves (synthetic: realized values from 20 replicates per cell without uncertainty, design values for the two negative-binomial-as-Poisson cells; the D = 241 dense-grid cells are included; crosses mark the sign-changing and misregistration cells, whose dependence the design effect does not capture); (b) REML + CL2 coverage of β against the same; axes cover all points; (c) NCV/REML MSE ratio for β against the REML/NCV EDF ratio of the ff term (plasmode: MID truth, EDF ratio of the two real-data fits; synthetic: all cells with a smooth truth at G = 100); (d) REML + CL2 coverage of β against G (synthetic: core cells at both G; plasmode: the G = all pool means, and in grey the same datasets at G = 40)."
#| fig-height: 6.2
#| warning: true
label_pts <- \(d) geom_text(data = d, aes(x, y, label = dataset), size = 2.2, vjust = -0.8, colour = "black")
sy <- syn_cells |> filter(estimand == "beta", G == 100, block %in% c("core", "dense_grid", "oscillating", "ar1_home", "heteroskedastic", "lowrank_covariate", "rough_truth", "basis_size"))
fam_cols <- c(gaussian = "#000000", poisson = "#56B4E9", binomial = "#CC79A7")
base <- \(xl, yl, ylim = NULL) list(labs(x = xl, y = yl), theme_doc, scale_colour_manual(values = fam_cols, name = "synthetic family"), scale_shape_manual(values = c(counted = 16, `stress test` = 17), name = "plasmode dataset"))
sy_de <- sy |> mutate(de_shape = if_else(error %in% c("osc", "warp"), "sign-changing / misregistration cell", "other synthetic cell"))
pa <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LEVEL, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(data = sy_de |> filter(de_shape == "other synthetic cell"), aes(DE_plot, reml_model, colour = family), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = sy_de |> filter(de_shape != "other synthetic cell"), aes(DE_plot, reml_model, colour = family), size = 1.6, shape = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = cross |> mutate(x = DE, y = reml_model_beta), aes(x, y, shape = role), size = 2.5) +
  label_pts(cross |> mutate(x = DE, y = reml_model_beta)) +
  base(de_label, "model-based coverage of beta") + ggtitle("(a)")
pb <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LEVEL, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(data = sy_de |> filter(de_shape == "other synthetic cell"), aes(DE_plot, reml_cl2, colour = family), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = sy_de |> filter(de_shape != "other synthetic cell"), aes(DE_plot, reml_cl2, colour = family), size = 1.6, shape = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = cross |> mutate(x = DE, y = reml_cl2_beta), aes(x, y, shape = role), size = 2.5) +
  label_pts(cross |> mutate(x = DE, y = reml_cl2_beta)) +
  base(de_label, "REML + CL2 coverage of beta") + ggtitle("(b)")
pc <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(data = sy |> filter(!is.na(edf_ratio), truth == "smooth"), aes(edf_ratio, ratio, colour = family), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = cross |> mutate(x = edf_ratio, y = ratio_MID_beta), aes(x, y, shape = role), size = 2.5) +
  label_pts(cross |> mutate(x = edf_ratio, y = ratio_MID_beta)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3)) + scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = fam_cols, name = "synthetic family") + scale_shape_manual(values = c(counted = 16, `stress test` = 17), name = "plasmode dataset") +
  labs(x = "EDF ratio REML / NCV of the ff term", y = "MSE NCV / MSE REML for beta") + theme_doc + ggtitle("(c)")
syG <- syn_cells |> filter(estimand == "beta", block == "core")
pd_ <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LEVEL, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_jitter(data = syG, aes(G, reml_cl2, colour = family), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6, width = 2, height = 0) +
  geom_point(data = cross |> mutate(x = G, y = reml_cl2_beta), aes(x, y, shape = role), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(data = cross |> mutate(x = 40, y = reml_cl2_beta - g40_loss_beta), aes(x, y, shape = role), size = 2.5, colour = "grey50", show.legend = FALSE) +
  label_pts(cross |> mutate(x = G, y = reml_cl2_beta)) +
  base("number of curves G", "REML + CL2 coverage of beta") + ggtitle("(d)")
fig <- (pa | pb) / (pc | pd_) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_fig(fig, "cross-study-scatter", 8, 7)
fig
```

```{r cross-table}
  sprintf("six families: model-based %s, REML + CL2 %s (smooth process, G = 100)", rng(c(syn_cov("reml_model", "fpc"), fv("reml_model"))), rng(c(syn_cov("reml_cl2", "fpc"), fv("reml_cl2")))),
  sprintf("β ratio %s across families", rng(c(syn_ratio("fpc"), MSE_RATIO$ratio[MSE_RATIO$block == "families" & MSE_RATIO$error == "fpc" & MSE_RATIO$estimand == "beta" & MSE_RATIO$fit_family == MSE_RATIO$family]))),
  "Gaussian only",
  "not testable",
  "Between-curve dependence",
  "not in the design (independent curves)",
  "—",
  sprintf("block-flip minus curve-flip coverage: REML + curve CL2 %s; block NCV/CL2 MSE ratio %s", rng_pp(bf_effect$diff[bf_effect$name == "coverage:reml_curvecl2"]), rng(bgain$estimate)),
  "plasmode only (imposed block dependence; curve-flip shortfalls are not evidence about it)",
  "Other remedies for dependent residuals (pcre, GLS, curve bootstrap)",
  sprintf("dependent, Gaussian: pcre β %s, GLS (FPCA) %s, REML + CL2 %s", rng(s_cv(s_cmp, "pcre", "synthetic, dependent")), rng(s_cv(s_cmp, "gls_fpc", "synthetic, dependent")), rng(s_cv(s_cmp, "reml_cl2", "synthetic, dependent"))),
  sprintf("β MSE pcre and GLS (FPCA) %s times NCV's", rng(s_cmp_mse$mse / s_cmp_mse$mse_ncv)),
  sprintf("pcre β %s, GLS (FPCA) %s; with CL2 %s and %s; bootstrap percentile %s; REML + CL2 %s", rng(s_cv(s_cmp, "pcre", "plasmode")), rng(s_cv(s_cmp, "gls_fpc", "plasmode")), rng(s_cv(s_ca, "pcre_cl2", "plasmode")), rng(s_cv(s_ca, "gls_fpc_cl2", "plasmode")), rng(s_cv(s_cmp, "boot_pct", "plasmode")), rng(s_cv(s_cmp, "reml_cl2", "plasmode"))),
  sprintf("pcre and GLS: synthetic coverage does not transfer (on real residual curves their estimates keep a bias that CL2 on the same fit does not remove); the curve bootstrap covers on both, at about %s times the time of REML + CL2", f(s_boot_time / s_remlcl2_time, 0)),
  "Intervals centred at the NCV fit with corrections",
  sprintf("smoothing-parameter term: NCV + CL2 β %s → %s (Gaussian, Poisson, dependent); binary G = 40 %s", rng(ncs(c("gaussian", "poisson"), "cl2")), rng(ncs(c("gaussian", "poisson"), "ij_lin")), f(ncs("binomial", "ij_lin", g = 40), 2)),
  "—",
  sprintf("one-step bias correction + smoothing-parameter term: β %s per dataset", rng(s_comb$coverage)),
  "does not transfer (smoothing bias of the NCV fit on real data remains)"
)
save_tab(cross_rows, "cross-study-assessment")
```

@tbl-cross summarises, property by property, what the synthetic study found and what the
nine plasmode datasets can say about it; the evidence behind each row is in the list that
follows. Associations across datasets are Spearman rank correlations over n = 9 (or the 6
counted) datasets with two-sided permutation p-values; at n = 9 a |rho| below about 0.6 is
uninformative, and the datasets' properties are confounded with each other and with the data
source. Each correlation uses, per dataset, the pool mean over its attached curve-flip cells
at G = all subjects (all truth × residual combinations) for coverages, the geometric mean over
residual sources of the MID-truth cell ratios for the NCV gain, the (MID truth, REML residual)
cell for AR(1), and the diagnostics of the REML residual curves (`cross-study-dataset-outcomes.csv`).
The synthetic study spans design effects `r rng(syn_de_span$lo, 0)`–`r rng(syn_de_span$hi, 0)` in its
dependent core cells (D = 61; `r if (has_de) "realized" else "design"` values; realized
values are means over 20 replicates without an uncertainty estimate and are missing for
`r nrow(de_missing)` cells, the negative-binomial data fitted as Poisson, where the design
values stand in); the plasmode datasets span `r rng(cross$DE, 0)` with grid sizes
`r rng(cross$D, 0)`. Because 1'Σ1/trΣ grows with the grid size, the normalisation
DE/D = (1'Σ1/trΣ)/D (`r rng(cross$DE_per_D, 2)`) is reported beside it. The design effect is
the grid-mean variance inflation and does not capture sign-changing or misregistration
dependence: the sign-changing cells have realized DE `r rng(de_osc, 1)` and the
misregistration cells `r rng(de_warp, 1)` while their model-based coverage is
`r rng(cov_oscwarp)`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cross
#| tbl-cap: "Cross-study assessment: for each data or model property varied in the synthetic study, its synthetic effect on inference and on estimation, what the plasmode data can say about it, and a verdict. Associations are Spearman rho with permutation p over the nine datasets unless marked counted only."
show(cross_rows)
```

```{r cross-sentences}
z_de <- rho_perm(cross$DE, cross$shortfall_model_beta)
z_ded <- rho_perm(cross$DE_per_D, cross$shortfall_model_beta)
z_edf <- rho_perm(cross$edf_ratio, cross$log_ratio_MID_beta)
z_sd <- rho_perm(cross$sd_ratio, cross$reml_cl2_beta)
z_sd_c <- rho_perm(cc$sd_ratio, cc$reml_cl2_beta)
resid_excess <- cross |> mutate(pred = predict(lm(shortfall_model_beta ~ log(DE), data = cross)), excess = shortfall_model_beta - pred) |> arrange(desc(excess))
min_de <- cross |> filter(DE == min(DE))
gain_order <- cross |> arrange(desc(ratio_MID_beta))
gain_order_c <- cc |> arrange(desc(ratio_MID_beta))
```

Evidence per row:

- *Dependence strength.* Model-based shortfall for β against DE: `r A("DE", "shortfall_model_beta")`;
  against DE/D: `r A("DE_per_D", "shortfall_model_beta")`. The dataset with the smallest DE,
  `r APP_LABELS[as.character(min_de$app)]` (DE `r f(min_de$DE, 1)`, DE/D `r f(min_de$DE_per_D, 2)`),
  still has a shortfall of `r pp(min_de$shortfall_model_beta)`; the dataset furthest above the
  shortfall-on-log-DE trend is `r APP_LABELS[as.character(resid_excess$app[1])]`. REML + CL2
  β coverage against DE: `r A("DE", "reml_cl2_beta")` (counted only `r A("DE", "reml_cl2_beta", cc)`).
- *Dependence shape.* `r APP_LABELS[as.character(min_de$app)]`'s residuals have the strongest
  sign-changing correlations of all datasets (minimum r `r f(min_de$min_r, 2)`) and the most
  extreme variance profile (SD ratio `r f(min_de$sd_ratio, 0)`). The design effect
  1'Σ1/trΣ is a grid-mean variance inflation that does not capture such features (see the
  sign-changing and misregistration cells above); REML + CL2
  β coverage against the SD ratio is `r f(z_sd$rho, 2)` (p = `r f(z_sd$p, 2)`) over all nine
  datasets and `r f(z_sd_c$rho, 2)` (p = `r f(z_sd_c$p, 2)`) over the counted six, i.e. driven by
  the stress tests.
- *Misregistration.* The two cardiac datasets with real misregistration (ECG strain
  `r f(100 * cross$phase_share[cross$app == "ecg_gls4b"], 0)`%, AF `r f(100 * cross$phase_share[cross$app == "af"], 0)`%)
  have REML + CL2 β coverage `r f(cross$reml_cl2_beta[cross$app == "ecg_gls4b"], 3)` and
  `r f(cross$reml_cl2_beta[cross$app == "af"], 3)` and AR(1) coverage `r f(cross$ar1_model_beta[cross$app == "ecg_gls4b"], 3)`
  and `r f(cross$ar1_model_beta[cross$app == "af"], 3)`; AR(1)'s lowest real-data coverages are
  on `r paste(APP_LABELS[as.character((cross |> arrange(ar1_model_beta) |> slice(1:2))$app)], collapse = " and ")`
  (phase shares `r paste(f(100 * (cross |> arrange(ar1_model_beta) |> slice(1:2))$phase_share, 0), collapse = "% and ")`%).
- *Number of curves.* Paired within-dataset losses at G = 40 are in @tbl-plasmode-g40 and
  the synthetic ones in @tbl-g40.
- *Covariate rank.* MID-truth β gain against rank: `r A("rank_X", "log_ratio_MID_beta")`;
  REML + CL2 β coverage against rank: `r A("rank_X", "reml_cl2_beta")` (counted only
  `r A("rank_X", "reml_cl2_beta", cc)`). Counted datasets ordered by REML + CL2 β coverage:
  `r paste(sprintf("%s %s", APP_LABELS[as.character(rank_cl2$app)], f(rank_cl2$reml_cl2_beta, 3)), collapse = ", ")`.
- *Truth roughness / EDF gap.* MID-truth β gain against the EDF ratio: `r f(z_edf$rho, 2)`
  (p = `r f(z_edf$p, 2)`, n = 9). Datasets ordered by the MID-truth ratio (largest gain last):
  `r paste(sprintf("%s %s (EDF ratio %s)", APP_LABELS[as.character(gain_order$app)], f(gain_order$ratio_MID_beta, 2), f(gain_order$edf_ratio, 2)), collapse = "; ")`.
  In @fig-cross (c) `r sum(cross$log_ratio_MID_beta < predict(lm(log(ratio) ~ log(edf_ratio), data = sy |> filter(truth == "smooth", !is.na(edf_ratio))), newdata = cross))` of 9
  datasets lie below the synthetic cells' log-log trend.
- *Signal.* Shortfall against R²: `r A("R2", "shortfall_model_beta")`; MID gain against R²:
  `r A("R2", "log_ratio_MID_beta")`.
- *Term type.* Datasets with resolved α(t) or γ(t) gains under the NCV truth   are listed in
  @sec-estimation-truth; the surface gain is the only one present on every dataset under the NCV and MID truths
  (`r sum(cross$ratio_NCV_beta < 1 & cross$ratio_MID_beta < 1)` of 9).
- *Basis size.* MID-truth β gains ordered: `r paste(sprintf("%s %s", APP_LABELS[as.character(rank_gain_all$app)], f(rank_gain_all$ratio_MID_beta, 2)), collapse = ", ")`;
  among the counted datasets ECG 8-lead ranks `r which(gain_order_c$app[order(gain_order_c$ratio_MID_beta)] == "ecg_roahd")` of 6 (1 = largest gain).
- *Other remedies.* Per-cell results and CL2 on the GLS and pcre fits: @sec-comparators, @sec-comp-cl2.
- *NCV-centred corrections.* Per-dataset results: @sec-ncv-intervals, @sec-lambda; all metrics of the main
  recipes side by side: @sec-metrics.
- *Between-curve dependence.* Block-flip minus curve-flip coverages per recipe and dataset:
  `r paste(sprintf("%s %s %s %s", bf_effect$dataset, ESTIMAND_LABELS[bf_effect$estimand], bf_effect$recipe, pp(bf_effect$diff)), collapse = "; ")`.

{{< include _computing-time.qmd >}}

# Limitations

```{r limitations}
n_rep <- unique(S$n_rep)
```

*Error law of the plasmode.* Sign-flipped frozen residual curves reproduce each subject's
empirical within-curve covariance exactly and nothing else: the error law is a two-point
mixture, symmetric by construction, with no between-subject variation in the residual
shapes beyond the observed ones. Residuals are attached to the subject's own covariates; on
the two datasets run both attached and detached, the two versions gave the same decisions.

*Frozen truths favour their own selector.* A truth taken from the REML fit is REML-shaped,
one from the NCV fit is NCV-shaped, and MID (log-midpoint smoothing parameters) is interior
for every term only on `r sum(DATASETS$mid_interior)` of 9 datasets. Changing the truth source
changes the truth's shape and signal as well as its smoothness, so the plasmode estimation
results are stated per truth source; the synthetic study is the only place where the truth
is independent of both selectors.

*Representable truths.* All synthetic truths of the main design are projected onto the fitted
bases, so approximation bias is absent by design; the rough-truth cells add roughness that the
bases can represent but the penalties shrink. Truths outside the spline space are studied only
in the misspecification experiment (@sec-misspec: Gaussian, three truths, two basis sizes).

*Precision.* `r n_rep` replicates give stored MC SEs of the grid-average coverage of
`r rng_pp(se_dep_cl2, 2)` (REML + CL2) to `r rng_pp(se_dep_model, 2)` (model-based) in the
dependent synthetic cells and `r rng_pp(se_plas_cl2, 2)` for REML + CL2 in the plasmode
cells; a single grid point's coverage has a binomial SE of `r pp(sqrt(0.95 * 0.05 / n_rep))`
near 0.95. A 2 pp undercoverage in one cell is therefore resolved for grid averages but
the rule's calibration error pools cells and subtracts the MC variance, and several plasmode
classes are "unresolved" because their bootstrap intervals straddle the 2 pp threshold.

*The calibration error.* The undercoverage-only CE selects the undercovering cells by their
estimated coverage before subtracting the MC variance, so the variance correction is
approximate (cells that undercover by chance are counted, cells that overcover by chance are
not).

*Two calibration criteria.* The undercoverage-only and the symmetric criterion are both
reported. Under both, the plasmode decision is inconsistent across datasets for β.

*Selected datasets.* The nine datasets were chosen to spread design effect, covariate rank
and phase variability, not sampled; three have dependent curves and are stress tests; all
are Gaussian; the ECG 8-lead model uses larger bases than the others; the running data
keep one condition per person with the other conditions' variation in the residuals; the
mean estimand is scored on a fixed cohort of 50 subjects. The cardiology datasets are not
public.

*Diagnostics.* The realized synthetic design effects are means over 20 replicates per cell
(`analysis/describe-cells.R`), without an uncertainty estimate.
The studentised-error diagnostics (`writeup/lrz-zstats.R`) cover all `r if (zs_avail) n_distinct(ZS$cell) else 0`
synthetic cells and all plasmode cells, for β everywhere and for the mean in Gaussian cells.

*Scope.* Simultaneous bands, G < 40, non-Gaussian real data, native-grid density on real
data, dependence models beyond AR(1), pcre and GLS (@sec-comparators) and the finite-sample calibration error of the
sandwich pivot itself are outside both studies.

CE = calibration error.
